newsitem.title: USA: Dow flirts with positive ground, techs weak.
newsitem.headline: Dow flirts with positive ground, techs weak.

text.p: The Dow flirted with positive ground then retreated in early afternoon trade on Monday, as most U.S. stocks faced profit-taking and jitters ahead of a speech by Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was off around 6.73 points at 7884, above session lows of 7840.
The Nasdaq composite extended Friday's losses, languishing at lower levels. It was down around 12 points at 1536.
The long bond was down 7/32 to yield 6.55 percent.
Greenspan would give a semi-annual testimony to Congress on the economy and monetary policy on Tuesday.
